City overview
SmartCity summary
As a city manager in the SmartCity simulation, your goal is to turn a traditional town into a modern SmartCity that is attractive for both residents and businesses. So your goal is to reach the highest SmartCity index that is possible! Competing cities in the region are also working towards this goal. Beyond the SmartCity Index, factors such as the mobility of residents and businesses play a crucial role in the success of your town. The SmartCity index, the main performance indicator of the simulation, is composed of several sub-indices and factors, which are listed below. Open the manual for more details.
SmartCity index =Economy * 0.25 +Environment * 0.2 +Governance * 0.15 +Living conditions * 0.15 +Mobility * 0.1 +People * 0.15
